scope: Four normal-rules seeded full-match diagnostics using the interim Ashe/Lux roster. The human carry is automated only for this audit. No accelerated clocks, altered rewards or forced winner.

sampling.everyTick: Finite x/y/hp/maxHp/mana/maxMana; bounded health and mana. First building destruction, active jobs, target attacks, point arrivals and shrine acquisition.
sampling.everyMinute: Full checkpoint validation and exact World.fromSnapshot round trip, also at terminal victory.
sampling.counters: Goal/arrival/attack counts are actor-ticks, and can exceed match ticks. They indicate policy activity, not successful jobs. Defense targets are friendly buildings, so zero attacks on defense targets is expected.
sampling.snapshots: Checkpoint file hash includes its trailing newline; canonicalStateSha256 hashes the serialized state without that newline.
